title: SXM-02 - Recovery journal
html:

  2. Source URL libwallet/obelisk from install-sx.sh they're coming back 404. libbitcoin obtained from the official repository, libwallet from EdgeApp (full story, section with MSVC), obelisk from the official history libbitcoin-server. BWallet It is used to compare archives. The first network requests from a limited environment were not allowed DNS; permitted The installers didn't start.
  3. Original git archive applied CRLF-Conversion of the environment; verification Git blob The export is replaced by cat-file --batch: file baseline Git blob. Project name error in export metadata also corrected prior to adoption SOURCE_PINS.
  4. The order of the dates of all branches was insufficient for the selection obelisk: later README-The committ is on another branch merge MSVC-port 661ba4f3 from 24 May containing define.hpp. The first photo is saved for comparison.
  5. Historical packages received NuGet from packages.config. Exclusion filter Test projects first mistakenly captured the name workspace «btc test»; corrected to a relative path 404 for libsodium 0.5.0.0 bounded normalized version in NuGet v3: righteous URL use 0.5.0.
  6. Locally SDK headlines added um/shared and x64 import libraries from formal ISO Microsoft, chosen only HTTP Range-Requests.

Toolset.props Microsoft plainly CTP/include beforehand VS2013/include. After correction configuration hd-seed.cpp compiled without modification SXM-01 overlay It was also missing: all of it RNG-the controls are repeated for x86/x64 rightly by the order of the headings; the exits coincided (RNG_RECHECK.json).
  8. Picture SX from 3 June: 79/80 library units pass through; stealth-show-addr demand absentee libwallet enum flags. Separately main.cpp giver C2440: return enum class console_result how int without cast. It's a real baseline incompatibility, not a reason to manually correct the historical code.
  9. In history, ready-made corrections were found: enum libwallet f7289e1b from 5 June SX 76813dd9 from 5 June6 June UTC). New full export and new compilation. hd-seed.cpp and utility/coin.cpp bystanderly 3 June. All 157 library units and console main They are compiled without editing the source.
  10. The linkage required the missing static CRT /MT. Received original Desktop x64 packet VS2013, The hashes matched the signed bootstrap manifest. MSI has Valid Authenticode. Trying to extract everything managed CRT libraries Identify a file that continues in the following CAB; This program doesn't need it. Included in the configuration are only fully extracted libcmt.lib/libcpmt.lib It's the same size as the full link SX successful.
  11. Separate Tooled Version: Type random_device into coin.cpp replaced by a test source uint32 and added entropy-track. Engine, distribution and HD-The code has not changed; saved diff. Systemic RNG controllably It's not called EXE check-in entropy-argument.
  12. First CLI-monitoring revealed staffing read_stream(trim=false): LF and CRLF remain in the key and are rejected is_base58. A separate experiment shows that precision xprv without the final translation of a line This is the type of input; the source does not correct pipe hd-seed → hd-priv It doesn't pretend to be a worker.
  13. The negative indices revealed a test expectation error: lexical_cast uint32 accepts1 how UINT32_MAX. It's written in INDEX_PARSING.json; Negative controls have been replaced by abc and 4294967296. Previous ones CALLS saved, full acceptance control is started with corrected waiting.

Completion, accurate counters and decision are reflected in RESULTS.md and COMPLETE.json. No networking commands SX And no full search Puzzle They didn't start.
